title: Shower Squeegee Solid Brass 15-Inch H With Wall Hook | Lavender | Squeegee Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Stop water spots and streaks before they dry on your shower door, tile, and mirrors in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This shower squeegee clears moisture in quick, easy strokes and stores neatly on the included decorative wall hook.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose a coordinated look with the distinctive Squeegee collection—made to complement transitional bathroom hardware
- Built for everyday bathroom use with solid brass construction and a replaceable blade

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 15 x 10 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 16 x 10 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall-mounted hook included
multiple designer finish options available
